description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tripoint Solutions develops technology solutions for federal government programs. The Salesforce Software Developer I builds, tests, and supports Salesforce functionality, including resolving production defects and handling technical end-user support cases.
Salesforce Software Developer I building and maintaining Flows, Apex, and Lightning Web Components; resolving defects and supporting testing

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components, validation rules, and page layouts from defined requirements
• Investigate and resolve production defects and end user support cases assigned to the development team
• Write unit tests and support user acceptance testing
• Perform data updates and corrections using Data Loader and related tools, following the approved request process
• Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, code review, and sprint demos
• Estimate work in hours, log time against assigned Jira tickets, and document solutions in Confluence
• Follow federal security hardening standards, Section 508 accessibility, and data privacy requirements in all development work

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
• Minimum of one year of professional software development experience
• Current hands-on Salesforce development experience in a production organization within the last 12 months
• Apex or Lightning Web Components shipped to a production org within the last 12 months
• Working knowledge of SOQL, Data Loader, and the Salesforce security model
• Active Salesforce Trailblazer account with a public profile
• U.S. citizenship
• Ability to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated federal background investigation
• Ability to handle and safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information
• Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (formerly Platform Developer I)
• One additional current Salesforce certification (Platform Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Agentforce Specialist)

Preferred:
• Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist
• Salesforce Education Cloud or EDA experience
• Experience supporting federal government technology programs
• Current favorably adjudicated federal background investigation
